lines.text: Many learners say: I have visited my aunt last year.
Better: I visited my aunt last year.
Last year is over, so use visited.
The second! I saw him last year.

native.tip: “-mış” eki çoğu zaman “have visited” gibi düşünülür; ama “last year” gibi bitmiş bir zamanla “visited” denir: “I visited my aunt last year.”
native.caption: “I have visited my aunt last year” mı diyorsun? 😅 “Last year” gibi bitmiş bir zaman varsa “have visited” değil, “visited” kullanılır. Doğrusu: “I visited my aunt last year.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “I saw him last year.” “Last year” gibi bitmiş bir zamanla “saw” gibi geçmiş biçimi kullan. Şimdi geçen yıl yaptığın bir şeyi yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: “-mış” is often thought of as “have visited,” but with a finished time like “last year,” English says “visited”: “I visited my aunt last year.”
en.caption: Do you say “I have visited my aunt last year”? 😅 With a finished time like “last year,” we say “visited,” not “have visited,” here. The right sentence is “I visited my aunt last year.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
